changes.text: Match each protein with its most appropriate description.

pairs.target: Responsible for the colloid osmotic pressure of the blood

changes.explanation: Collagen is fibrous and hemoglobin is globular. Plasma proteins, especially albumin, maintain colloid osmotic pressure. Chaperones assist protein folding. Zein lacks sufficient lysine and tryptophan, while milk proteins provide a balanced essential amino-acid profile.
